Plan_of_Care.content: For acute URI, patient to purchase a thermometer and monitor temperature
Continue Lemsip as needed and avoid other paracetamol-containing products

Plan_of_Care.content: Seek care if fever is 37.5–38°C or higher and persistent or worsening, or if cough worsens, purulent sputum develops, hemoptysis or epistaxis occurs, or shortness of breath or chest pain develops
